system_configurations.name: RCCL Host Tests
system_configurations.description: CPU-only host-path tests that need no GPU and no RCCL build. Currently the device-kernel leak guards (pytest): run src/device/generate.py (rocSHMEM OFF/ON) and src/device/symmetric/generate.py and assert the generated kernel set (grand total, per-collective counts, per-dimension value-sets) against committed baselines. Intended to also host other host-only tests over time. build_configuration.requires_build = false: these suites exercise only the generators/host code (never librccl), so the runner skips both the RCCL build and the librccl.so environment check.

tests.name: KernelCount_Guards_All
tests.description: Assert the generated device-kernel set (main + symmetric generators) against committed baselines; fails with an actionable diff on any unreviewed kernel-count change.

test_suites.name: Kernel-Count Guards
test_suites.description: CPU-only device-kernel leak guards via pytest; no GPU required.
